readerCopy.body: Nostalgia can edit an old situation until returning looks easier than remembering why the old version stopped working. When Neptune opposes the North Node, memory and forward movement face each other directly, making an old relationship, dream, identity, belief, or plan especially easy to idealize while the new direction remains unfinished. Something valuable may still belong to the past. Recovering the value is different from rebuilding a decision around the missing context.
